header.title: Grant & Co Consultants  Home Buying & Credit Readiness Intake

fields.label: Full Name
fields.helptext: Enter your full legal name as it appears on government ID.

fields.label: Phone Number
fields.helptext: Provide a number we can use to contact you about your home purchase.

fields.label: Email Address
fields.helptext: We will use this email for all communications and account setups.

fields.label: Date of Birth
fields.exampleFormat: 08-06-1991 (as shown on URLA PDF); Cognito culture pattern M/d/yyyy

fields.label: Social Security Number
fields.securityNote: Plaintext text input. Form encrypt flag false. OS must vault; never log full SSN.

fields.label: Current Address (Full address with city, state, zip)
fields.helptext: Provide your current residential address including city, state, and postal code.

fields.label: Upload Driver’s License or State ID
fields.helptext: Upload a clear, readable photo or scan of your government-issued ID (front and back if possible).

fields.label: Are you including Credit Repair with your Home Package?
fields.helptext: Select Yes if you want credit repair included. Select No if you will provide MyFICO mortgage scores.
choices: Yes — Requires Credit Hero Score account

fields.label: Upload screenshot or confirmation of Credit Hero Score account
fields.requiredNote: Schema has no required:true. Helper text says required if Yes selected. Template has no v-if hide.
fields.helptext: Required if you selected Yes above. Upload a screenshot or confirmation showing your Credit Hero Score account creation.

fields.title: Credit Repair Instruction (If Yes)
fields.htmlPlain: You must create a Credit Hero Score account immediately after submitting this form. This is required to begin your credit process.

fields.label: Upload MyFICO mortgage score screenshot
fields.requiredNote: Schema has no required:true. Helper text says required if No selected. Template has no v-if hide.
fields.helptext: Required if you selected No above. Upload a screenshot of your MyFICO mortgage scores (must meet minimum qualifying score of 620).

fields.title: MyFICO Instruction (If No)
fields.htmlPlain: You must provide your MyFICO mortgage scores. Minimum qualifying score is 620.

fields.label: I am interested in Down Payment Assistance (+$1,800)
fields.helptext: Checking this will add Down Payment Assistance to your package for an additional $1,800.

fields.title: Down Payment Assistance Note
fields.htmlPlain: Down Payment Assistance will be added to your package. This still keeps you at a discounted rate compared to standard closing costs. We recommend new construction homes such as DR Horton to maximize incentives.

sections.label: Section 5: Process Disclosure

fields.title: Account Creation Disclosure
fields.htmlPlain: You understand that a separate name, phone number, and email will be created on your behalf for lender and transaction purposes. Upon closing, you will receive all login credentials and account access.

fields.title: Agent Assignment
fields.htmlPlain: Our in-house agent, Taylor Carroll, will assist with showings, negotiations, and transaction coordination throughout the home buying process.

sections.acknowledgementCheckbox: NOT FOUND (shown as HTML only; covered only by final I-agree)

fields.label: I agree not to apply for new credit during this process
I agree not to make large purchases
I agree not to add or remove accounts without approval
I understand this may negatively impact my approval
fields.helptext: Acknowledges that changes to credit or accounts may negatively impact loan approval.

sections.label: Section 7: Payment & Commitment
sections.note: No payment-processor field on this form (paymentProcessor None; Require_Payment_Expression false). These are acknowledgements only.

fields.label: I understand this is a non-refundable service and payment must be made before services begin
fields.helptext: By checking, you acknowledge payment is non-refundable and required prior to service start.

fields.label: I understand services will not begin until payment has cleared
I understand that if I cancel after starting this process, I will incur a $1,800 cancellation fee payable to the realty company
fields.helptextHtml: Acknowledges the $1,800 cancellation fee if you cancel after the process has started.

fields.label: I understand this is not a process where I can start and change my mind

sections.label: Section 9: Legal Disclosure

fields.title: No Guarantees
fields.htmlPlain: No outcome, credit score increase, loan approval, interest rate, or property acquisition is guaranteed.

fields.title: Client Financial Responsibilities
fields.htmlPlain: Client is responsible for all home buying costs including inspections, appraisals, earnest money, down payment, and closing costs.

sections.acknowledgementCheckbox: NOT FOUND (shown as HTML only; covered only by final I-agree)

fields.label: Full Name (Typed Signature)
fields.helptext: Type your full legal name as your electronic signature.

fields.label: Signature (Drawn)
fields.helptext: Draw your signature in the signature field.

fields.label: Date (Auto)
fields.helptext: This date will be auto-populated with the date you sign.
fields.defaultOrCalcInModel: NOT FOUND (no default/get on the DateAuto type; auto-fill behavior UNKNOWN beyond helptext)
